subject: Platform integration blueprint review — scheduling request
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@olivehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Platform integration blueprint review — scheduling request

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at OliveHealth wants to run a focused architecture review next week to align on the hosted API integration and confirm SDK + streaming behavior for our high-throughput workflows. High level goals:

- Walk through the proposed request flow (client SDK -> Redwood hosted API -> function/tool calls)
- Understand streaming tokenization and backpressure behavior for our 3s latency SLO
- Validate caching and KV patterns for session continuity across restarts
- Confirm deployment options if we later move to dedicated capacity

We're targeting a 60-minute technical session with engineers and infra. Who from your side should join? Our attendees: Samir Khan (me), Priya Desai (platform lead), and a DevOps engineer.

Availability windows (PDT) we can do next week:
- Mon 10/19 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Tue 10/20 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00

If those don't work, happy to propose alternates.

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Platform Engineering Manager
OliveHealth

P.S. attaching a short internal outline of the topics we want to cover (attached as olive_integration_agenda-v1.pdf).

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform integration blueprint review — scheduling request

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear goals and the attachment. Really helpful.

We can absolutely run that session and will aim to keep it hands-on and decision-oriented. Proposed plan (60m):

1) 5m quick intros and goals
2) 20m walkthrough of request/response flow and streaming behavior (SDKs, client buffering)
3) 15m KV/prefix caching and deployment patterns for session continuity
4) 10m function/tool calling & structured output discussion (security/evidence)
5) 10m Q&A + next steps / mutual action items

From our side I'd like to include: Marissa Cole (Solutions Architect) for the runtime patterns, Aditya Rao (AE) for rollout/contract questions, and myself to run the demo. If helpful we'll also invite an infra engineer (Sergio) for kernel/quantization/QPS items.

For slots, we can do:
- Mon 10/19 15:30–16:30 PDT (preferred)
- Tue 10/20 09:30–10:30 PDT (alternate)

I created a draft agenda in case you want to add specifics: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AqL-olive-integration-blueprint (I've added the SDK topics).

Attaching a short tech playbook we typically share in these sessions (redwood-technical-playbook.pdf). I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm which slot you prefer.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-technical-playbook.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform integration blueprint review — scheduling request

Looping in Sergio because he'll want to cover a couple kernel/quantization tradeoffs if we start talking about dedicated vs hosted variants. Also, two quick asks for the agenda that will make the session more actionable:

- Can we include a short live demo of streaming with a ~2k token prompt and show how the SDK surfaces partial responses? (10–12m)
- Please include a small section on function/tool calling security model (auth headers, callback patterns) and any telemetry hooks we can expect in the console.

If Samir confirms Mon 10/19 15:30 that works for us. If we end up on Tue 9:30 please note Sergio is only available Tue after 10:00 — he can join the tail of the session.

Marissa
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@olivehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, partner@cloudintegrate.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform integration blueprint review — scheduling request

Thanks Mina / Marissa — appreciate the fast turnaround and the agenda.

Quick note: we had a last-minute conflict on Mon 10/19 and need to move the session. Our earliest opens are:
- Tue 10/20 14:00–15:00 PDT
- Wed 10/21 09:00–10:00 PDT

Tue 14:00 would work well for our West Coast folks; does that work for the Redwood team? Also, if Sergio can only do Tue after 10:00 that's fine — he won't need to be there for the full hour.

I'll wait for your confirmation and then we can lock it and I'll share attendee calendar invites from my side as well.

Thanks,
Samir

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform integration blueprint review — scheduling request

Hi Samir — Tue 10/20 14:00–15:00 PDT works for the Redwood side. I'll send a calendar invite from our tenant shortly (attach invite.ics) and include an agenda + links.

Action items after this session we expect:
- Mutual action plan with owners and acceptance criteria (I'll capture)
- If we identify dedicated capacity needs we'll follow up with a throughput/quantization runbook and cost estimate (Aditya to own)
- Sergio will provide a short note on kernel/quantization constraints for any follow-on work

I'll include the meeting recording permission for your team and a link to the console trace hook docs in the invite.

See you Tuesday — thanks everyone for the quick coordination.

Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invite.ics
